title: Greek Yogurt with Honey and Walnuts
summary: A simple Greek breakfast of thick yogurt drizzled with honey and topped with crunchy walnuts. It’s creamy, sweet, and ready in minutes for a light start to the day.
steps: Divide the Greek yogurt between two bowls.
Drizzle the honey evenly over the yogurt.
Scatter the chopped walnuts on top and add a tiny pinch of salt if using.
Serve immediately while the yogurt is cold and the nuts are crunchy.
